authorization: User explicitly requested attempt 1: start cracking and record the approach whether successful or not.
hypothesis: The rune-bearing LP2/0..55 material uses the literal LP2/56 prime-minus-one stream without additional key material or unknown skips under one of four structural clocks.
mechanistic_basis: C004/C013: LP2/56 exact known prime-minus-one reproduction; H002 pending boundary semantics motivate explicit competing clocks. This batch does not assume H002 has passed and does not transplant ordinal 56 to other pages.
falsifiable_predictions: A correct fixed clock should yield a complete rune stream with independently trained English rune-frequency alignment beyond a corpus-wide permutation maximum.
Synthetic texts encrypted with each of the four clocks must be recovered exactly by the matching branch; wrong branches are recorded separately.
Known LP2/56 with documented skip56 remains a separate baseline, not a claim that this no-skip extension is already validated.
data_versions: data/attempt1-corpus-v1.json and sources/attempt1-manifest.json hashes frozen into each run before any candidates
data/synthetic/training.txt existing independent 1291-rune training corpus; heldout.txt only accessible to validation/generation
page_universe: LP2 numeric pages 0..55, all 56 covered in coverage table
applicable_objects: All 55 pages with registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed literal pages 49 and 51

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune glyphs in pinned master; literal grid only. Not tested and not a negative result.

algorithm_version: H006-v1; P_i=(C_i-(prime[t_i]-1)) mod29; first prime=2, t zero-based
parameter_derivation_policy: Only the four structural clocks below. offset=0, subtract direction, shift=1, no skip. No keyword, offset, direction, affine, or arbitrary key enumeration.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: page/line/paragraph each start at prime2 on every page; corpus continues rune clock through numeric pages 0..55 starting LP2/0, ignoring every delimiter and literal. LP2/50 consumes zero positions. No inferred chapter boundaries.

reset_branches.line: Reset on page start and literal slash /; newline is formatting
reset_branches.paragraph: Reset on page start and ampersand & only; dollar/section sign have no additional reset

literals_and_ambiguity: All non-runes and uncertain separators retained unchanged, consume no prime. No glyph normalization. Missing image-region/glyph review and numeric grid consumption are explicit limitations.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: Sum log((training_count[index]+1)/(N+29)); fixed training-only orthography in lp_lab.synthetic.encode_text
scorer_and_acceptance_version.statistic: Exact permutation-conditional mean and variance for fixed delta and ciphertext rune counts; Z=(score-mean)/sqrt(variance); zero variance is nondiscriminating Z=0
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead_gate: Adjusted Monte Carlo p <= 0.01 using (1+#null_max>=observed_Z)/1000. A lead is inconclusive, not deciphered.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative: All registered branches for a page completed and none meets the lead gate: no frequency-alignment lead under this scoped null and scorer; not proof all prime ciphers fail.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.decipherment: Never from score or roundtrip alone. Requires exact full-rune output plus a new independently checked structural/key prediction; otherwise inconclusive.

frozen_before_candidates: Runner records specification, source, scorer, code hashes and UTC timestamp before worker dispatch; refuses overwritten run directories.

total_budget.unique_evaluations: at most 220; deduplicate full per-page mod29 delta vectors
total_budget.origin: Concrete conservative local batch selected for current explicit start request; statistical controls are not additional key candidates; no budget inherited from side-chat

controls: Exact existing LP2/56 and 57 baseline, documented no-skip negative retained
Four synthetic clock families, two 256-rune pages each, fixed heldout text; generator/answer separate from guarded worker; exact branch and plaintext checks
999 independent corpus permutations: shuffle each page once per replicate; reuse it across that page's branches; preserve rune multisets and boundaries
Independent prime arithmetic, clock derivation, per-rune output and reverse transform verification
Read-denial probe and public-input field whitelist in -I -S subprocess
correlated_transform_deduplication: Within each page, hash/compare complete mod29 delta tuple; keep method aliases. No dedup based on equal score. Max uses unique vectors.
multiple_testing_policy: One maxZ per full-corpus permutation across every unique page/clock candidate. Controls candidate selection under the joint page-wise exchangeability null; not a probability of correct decipherment, nor proof against other nonrandom cipher families.

control_randomness.role: Reproducible permutation-control seed only; never an encryption key seed and never passed to candidate worker

discovery_path: Guarded worker only receives public ciphertext indices, boundary ordinals and frozen training counts. No reference answers, hidden key or generation seed.
independent_validation_path: Orchestrator recomputes prime values and clocks by a different implementation, compares every rune and preserves raw delimiters; stats module checks controls. Synthetic heldout answers never passed to worker.
note: Specification remains immutable after execution. Runtime results live in append-only runs; parameter changes require a new hypothesis version. No internet acquisition or upstream script execution.
